A soulful Bollywood sad song that brings back the nostalgia, romance and emotional magic of classic 90s Hindi cinema. If you love 90s Bollywood songs, romantic sad songs and evergreen Hindi melodies, this one is sure to touch your heart.

recentItems.description:
Chori Chori Maine Bhi To  | Dalaal |Mithun Chakraborty  Ayesha Jhulka |Kumar Sanu, Kavita Krishnamurthy 

Relive the magic of 90s Bollywood with the evergreen romantic song “Chori Chori Maine Bhi To” from the movie Dalaal. Featuring Mithun Chakraborty & Ayesha Jhulka, this melodious track is beautifully sung by Kumar Sanu & Kavita Krishnamurthy. 
With music by the legendary Bappi Lahiri and lyrics by Anjaan, the song brings back the nostalgic charm of classic Hindi cinema and timeless 90s romance.

🎵 Song: Chori Chori Maine Bhi To
🎤 Singers: Kumar Sanu & Kavita Krishnamurthy
🎼 Music: Bappi Lahiri
✍️ Lyrics: Anjaan
🎬 Movie: Dalaal
⭐ Starring: Mithun Chakraborty, Raj Babbar, Ayesha Jhulka, Shakti Kapoor, Ravi Behl & Others
🎥 Director: Partho Ghosh
